name: tiling_cache_locality
description: Tile loop nests to maximize temporal and spatial reuse within L1/L2 cache hierarchy. Partitions iteration spaces into fixed-size blocks to fit intermediate results and operands within cache capacity.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes for consecutive loops in the tiled operation. Each element corresponds to one loop level; 0 means no tiling for that level. For matmul, typically [tile_I, tile_J, tile_K]. For conv_2d, typically [tile_N, tile_C, tile_H, tile_W, tile_F, tile_KH, tile_KW] or a subset.

parameters.name: operation_name
parameters.description: Optional filter to target specific operation by name attribute (e.g., 'matmul', 'conv_2d'). If not provided, matches any tiling-eligible linalg operation.
